ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if(vars.bodyResponse != []) vars.bodyResponse else payload

%dw 2.0 output application/json var profile = upper((Mule::p('pagination.profile') default "Bajo") as String) var maxLimit = if (profile == "ALTO") ((Mule::p('pagination.profiles.alto.max') default 100) as Number) else if (profile == "MEDIO") ((Mule::p('pagination.profiles.medio.max') default 50) as Number) else ((Mule::p('pagination.profiles.bajo.max') default 25) as Number) var defaultLimit = maxLimit var defaultOffset = (Mule::p('pagination.default.offset') default 0) as Number var reqLimit = (vars.parameters.limit default defaultLimit) as Number var reqOffset = (vars.parameters.offset default defaultOffset) as Number var limit = if (reqLimit > maxLimit) maxLimit else if (reqLimit < 0) 0 else reqLimit var offset = if (reqOffset < 0) 0 else reqOffset var payloadArr = if (payload is Array) payload else null var lastIndex = if (payloadArr is Array) sizeOf(payloadArr) - 1 else -1 var toIndex = if (payloadArr is Array) min([offset + limit - 1, lastIndex]) else -1 --- if (payload is Array) if (sizeOf(payloadArr) == 0 or offset > lastIndex) [] else payloadArr[offset to toIndex] else payload
